# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.8.2

**See how your run went.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **A results screen after every single-player run**, inspired by Pac-Man CE DX. Over the Game Over screen:
  - your **score over time**, drawn in as it appears, with small marks for deaths and bombs and a star on your best moment (say, "Snake +69,925");
  - the **enemies you destroyed**, most points first, each with its own little neon icon;
  - your **Black holes** and **Gates** totals. Gates count everything caught in their blasts, so in Pacifism they are your whole score;
  - how long the run lasted, and your **best gate blast**.

  It follows your interface colour (Rainbow gets a rainbow line), takes no input, so **Continue** and **Retry** work at once, and goes when you leave the Game Over screen. Turn it off with **Results screen** on the launcher's **Gameplay** page.
- **Deadline's hidden spawn rank, if you want it.** Turn on **Deadline rank info** (Gameplay page, off by default) and the HUD shows **K** (your weighted kills since the last wave), **G** (geoms collected) and **Rank 20 > 32**: the rank now, and what the next wave will make it. A "+12" pops when a wave raises it. It only shows information, so runs still count online.
- **Steadier sound in busy modes.** The audio queue is longer by default (16 frames instead of 8), which keeps the sound in step through Evolved and Sequence at about 43 ms more delay. Some drift above 60 FPS remains; 60 FPS sounds best for now.

Everything from v0.8.1 is still here: your colour on the menus, HUD, icons and crosshair, nearby players and your next rival.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.8.2-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
